a statistical model-based segmentation algorithm is proposed and it is used for video object extraction and rate control in very low bit-rate applications.

(1) the statistical model-based video object segmentation algorithm produces good segmentation results for typical videophone videoconference applications, (2) the segmentation algorithm can be used to improve the perceptual quality in H.263 compatible coding, and (3) a distortion model can be used to incorporate subjective factors into the objective rate control.
